messages:
maya.sec: Customer reported an import that shows no operator_witness in prod logs (X-Request-Id: cust-9f3). Can we triage quickly?
aud it-bot: Ingested log slice: s3://redwood-logs/prod/hsm/2026/03/19/cust-9f3.json (sha256: abc123).
owen.runtime: Checking RBAC history now. Any recent allowlist changes for automated imports?
maya.sec: We rolled a short-lived allowlist for svc-migration last week; intended for staging only.
ria.oncall: Correlated request: 2026-03-19T23:12:08Z -> proxy-v2 -> status=200 -> operator_witness_id=null -> auth.principal=svc-migration.
owen.runtime: That matches: PR #5320 accidentally scoped to prod. Rolling back and rotating svc-migration tokens.
claire.compliance: Customer needs SOC2 evidence: timeline, PRs, logs, mitigation steps. Don't purge originals.
ria.oncall: Mitigation done: tokens rotated, RBAC reverted, temporary prod guard requiring operator_witness applied. I'll export annotated logs to s3://redwood-compliance/evidence/INC-2742/pack.zip.
maya.sec: Follow-ups: (1) add E2E test to prevent allowlist drift, (2) enforce immutable audit markers when skip_operator_witness is applied, (3) postmortem doc. Meeting in 30m.
